# ObsidianUltra

Fork of Obsidian (deividcomsono/Obsidian) for Roblox exploit UIs. All upstream Obsidian
APIs work unchanged. This file lists ONLY what the fork adds/changes. Types:
`Library.d.luau`. Runnable usage: `Example.lua`.

```lua
local repo = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joustingmatch/ObsidianUltra/main/"
local Library = loadstring(game:HttpGet(repo .. "Library.lua"))()
```

---

## Tab layout: single column

```lua
Window:AddTab({ Name = "Info", Icon = "square", SingleColumn = true })
-- or Layout = "Single" | "Center" | "Centre" | "One" | 1   (default: "Dual" | 2)
```

Both `AddLeftGroupbox` and `AddRightGroupbox` land in the one column. Sub tabs inherit it.

## Sub tabs

Second tab level inside a sidebar tab. Rendered twice from one object: a button row above
the tab content, and a collapsible nested list in the sidebar. Not a Tabbox (a Tabbox is a
widget inside one column; a sub tab owns the whole content area with its own two columns).

```lua
local Sub = Tab:AddSubTab("PvP", "shield")          -- or Tab:AddSubTab({ Name=, Icon= })
Sub:AddLeftGroupbox("Aiming"):AddToggle("A", { Text = "Silent Aim" })
```

SubTab methods: `AddGroupbox`, `AddLeftGroupbox`, `AddRightGroupbox`, `AddTabbox`,
`AddLeftTabbox`, `AddRightTabbox`, `Show`, `Hide`, `SetVisible`, `Hover`, `Resize`,
`RefreshSides`, `Destroy`.
SubTab fields: `Type="SubTab"`, `Name`, `Window`, `Tab`, `Canvas`, `Button`, `Sides`,
`Groupboxes`, `Tabboxes`, `DependencyGroupboxes`.

Parent tab additions: `Tab.SubTabs` (`{[Name]: SubTab}`), `Tab.ActiveSubTab`,
`Tab:SetExpanded(bool)`, `Tab:ToggleExpanded()`, `Tab:IsExpanded()`,
`Tab:GetContentOffset()` (px reserved by warning box + button row),
`Tab:SetSubTabAlignment("Left"|"Center"|"Right")` (default Center).

Rules:
- **A tab with sub tabs hides its own columns.** Put groupboxes on the sub tabs.
- First sub tab added is shown automatically.
- `SubTab:SetVisible(false)` hides its button; falls through to another if it was active.
- Search hides non-matching sub tab buttons and jumps off an empty active sub tab.
- Warning boxes stay on the parent tab (`Tab:UpdateWarningBox`).
- Use `Library:GetActiveSides()`, not `Library.ActiveTab.Sides` (wrong with sub tabs).
- Sidebar: chevron toggles the list without switching; only one list open at a time.
  Still shown when compact, as icon-only rows.

## Tabbox (changed)

`Tabbox:AddTab(Name, IconName)` — name, icon, or both (`""` name = icon-only).
Buttons are an icon/text strip with one sliding accent underline (`Animations.SubTabUnderline`)
and a content-switch slide (`Animations.TabSwitch`).

## Header (changed)

- The open tab's name is always shown; `Description` fills a faded second line.
- `Window:ShowTabInfo(Name, Description)` accepts nil/empty description (hides line 2).
- Search box is a pill (registered in `Library.PillCorners`).
- `SearchbarSize` defaults to `UDim2.fromScale(0.35, 1)`; tab info fills the remainder.
- Right side: notification bell + minimize button (when `Minimizable`).

## Sidebar resize / compact

```lua
Library:CreateWindow({
    EnableSidebarResize = true,      -- DEFAULT TRUE in this fork; false removes the handle
    MinSidebarWidth = 128,           -- >= 64
    SidebarCompactWidth = 48,        -- >= 48
    SidebarCollapseThreshold = 0.5,  -- where the drag snaps to compact
    DisableCompactingSnap = false,
    CompactWidthActivation = nil,    -- width that reads as compact when snap is off
    SidebarCompacted = false,
})
Window:SetSidebarWidth(px) / :GetSidebarWidth() / :SetCompact(bool) / :IsSidebarCompacted()
```

Compact = icons only (title, tab labels, chevrons hidden). Live flag:
`Library.SidebarCompacted`. Separate from Minimize (which collapses the whole window).

## Tooltips

`Library:AddTooltip(Info, DisabledInfo, HoverInstance, Variant?)` — 4th arg is new.
`Variant = "Sidebar"` shows the tooltip only while the sidebar is compact; anything else
is a normal tooltip. Tabs/sub tabs get a Sidebar tooltip of their name automatically;
override with `Tooltip = "..."` on `AddTab`. Tooltips fade+scale in (~0.22s).

## Dropdowns: Select All / Deselect All

```lua
Groupbox:AddDropdown("Materials", { Values = V, Multi = true, SelectAllButtons = true })
Dropdown:SelectAll(Search?) / Dropdown:DeselectAll(Search?)
```

Multi only. Skips disabled values; respects the active search. Fires the callback once.
`DeselectAll` keeps one value when `AllowNull = false`.

## Dropdowns: expand panel

```lua
Groupbox:AddDropdown("Materials", {
    Values = V, Multi = true, Searchable = true,
    Expandable = true,   -- default; adds an expand button beside the arrow
    ExpandColumns = 3,   -- default 2
})
Dropdown:Expand() / :Collapse() / :ToggleExpanded() / :IsExpanded()
```

Same dropdown state, shown in an overlay panel. Closes on X, click-off, or (single-select)
picking a value. One panel at a time: `Library.ActiveExpandedDropdown`. Parented to
`Library.MainFrame`; no window = `Expand` no-ops. Panel searchbar is separate from the
inline one and clears on open.

## Priority dropdown

Drag-to-rank list; no selection state, `Value` is the ordered array (highest first).

```lua
local P = Groupbox:AddPriorityDropdown("TargetPriority", {
    Text = "Target Priority",
    Values = { "Closest", "Lowest Health", "Highest Threat" },
    Default = { "Lowest Health" },   -- optional partial order; omitted values append
    Searchable = true,               -- default; drag is disabled while filtered
    Expandable = true,               -- default
    MaxVisibleDropdownItems = 8,
    Callback = function(Order) end,  -- fires once on drop
})
```

Methods: `GetValue()` (copy), `SetValue(Order)`, `SetValues(Values)`, `OnChanged(fn)`,
`SetText`, `SetDisabled`, `SetVisible`, `Expand`, `Collapse`, `IsExpanded`,
`ToggleExpanded`.
Notes: whole row is the drag handle, mouse+touch, auto-scroll near edges. `SetValue`/
`SetValues` ignore unknown values and keep omitted ones at the bottom. Saves with
SaveManager as the ranked order. Searching reorders the view only. Shares
`Library.ActiveExpandedDropdown`.

## Search v2

```lua
Library:CreateWindow({
    FuzzySearch = true,        -- also Library.FuzzySearch
    SearchValues = true,       -- also Library.SearchValues
    SearchKeybind = Enum.KeyCode.F,   -- Ctrl is always required
    DisableSearchKeybind = false,
})
```

- Case-insensitive, pattern-safe (literal `(`, `%`, `-`, `+`, `[`).
- Fuzzy = subsequence match, only for queries of 2+ non-whitespace chars.
- `SearchValues` also searches: dropdown entries + current selection (via
  `FormatListValue`/`FormatDisplayValue`, max 100 entries per element per update), input
  values, key picker key+mode. Not searched: toggle/slider/colour values.
- Matching a groupbox / Tabbox tab / sub tab name reveals its normally-visible contents
  (never un-hides script-hidden elements).
- **Ctrl+F** focuses the searchbar (not while another textbox has focus); **Escape**
  clears and unfocuses. `DisableSearch = true` removes search and both shortcuts.
- `GlobalSearch` still controls all-tabs vs active-tab.

## Minimize

Collapses the window to a card. Not the same as sidebar compacting.

```lua
Library:CreateWindow({
    Minimizable = true,                          -- default
    MinimizeKeybind = Enum.KeyCode.RightBracket, -- optional, no default
    MinimizedWidth = 300,
    MinimizedSubtitle = "",   -- "" = track the open tab
    AutoMinimize = false,     -- start collapsed, one-time
})
Window:SetMinimized(bool) / :ToggleMinimized() / :IsMinimized()
Window:SetMinimizedSubtitle(Text)  -- "" hands it back to the tab name
Window:AddMinimizedLabel(Text) -> { SetText, SetVisible, Destroy }
Window:ClearMinimizedLabels()
```

Card is built automatically when `Minimizable`: header (icon, title, subtitle, restore
chevron) + optional labels + the window footer as plain text (no copy buttons). Opens at
the window's last position; restoring moves the window to the card's position. Keybind
ignored while a textbox is focused; hidden while the UI is toggled off. Mirrors the
notification bell.

## Footer (copyable)

```lua
-- string form
Library:CreateWindow({ Footer = "version: example", CopyableFooter = true })

-- list form: bare strings are plain; tables need Copyable = true
Library:CreateWindow({ Footer = {
    "version: example |",
    { Text = "discord.gg/mspaint", Copyable = true },
    { Text = "user id", Copyable = true, CopyText = "123" },   -- copies CopyText
}})
Window:SetFooter(Footer)   -- accepts either form
```

Copyable segments render in `Scheme.BlueColor` with a copy button (icon flips to a check
~1.5s). `CopyableFooter` applies to the string form only. Clipboard is resolved once as
`setclipboard or toclipboard or syn.write_clipboard`; if absent, everything falls back to
plain text with no copy buttons.

## Watermark status bar

Segmented bar; `Text` may be a function, re-evaluated every `RefreshRate` seconds.

```lua
local W = Library:AddWatermark({
    { Player = LocalPlayer, NameType = "Username" },   -- avatar + name
    { Icon = "flame", Text = "mspaint", Accent = true },
    { Icon = "wifi", Text = function() return GetPing() .. " ms" end },
})
W.RefreshRate = 1
```

Segment fields: `Text` (string | `() -> string`), `Icon`, `Accent`, `Player`/`PlayerCard`,
`NameType`.

## Player cards

`AddPlayerInfo(Idx, Info)` — on a **tab** = full-width banner above both columns; on a
**groupbox** = compact avatar box.

```lua
Tab:AddPlayerInfo("Banner", {
    Player = nil, UserId = nil,      -- defaults to the local player
    Title = "Welcome <b>here</b>",   -- RichText
    Description = { "line 1", "line 2" },  -- string | {string}, RichText
    ThumbnailType = "HeadShot",      -- "HeadShot" | "Bust" | "Avatar"
    Thumbnail = nil,                 -- custom icon overriding the avatar
    Height = 84,                     -- MINIMUM height; banner grows to fit
    Visible = true,
})
```

Methods: `SetTitle`, `SetDescription`, `SetPlayer`, `SetUserId`, `SetThumbnail`,
`SetHeight`, `SetVisible`, `GetTotalHeight`.

## Discord box

`Groupbox:AddDiscordBox(Idx, Info)` — a Discord-style promo card (banner, circular
avatar overlapping its bottom edge, status dot, name block, action buttons). Nothing is
Discord-specific in code: every image, colour, label and action is passed in. Works in any
groupbox, tabbox tab or dependency box.

```lua
local Card = Groupbox:AddDiscordBox("Community", {
    Banner = 0,          -- asset id / rbxassetid:// / custom-asset url / lucide name
    BannerColor = nil,   -- Color3 or scheme name; fallback when Banner is unset (default Accent)
    Avatar = 0,
    AvatarColor = nil,

    Title = "Ouroboros Hub",
    Subtitle = "Scripts, updates & support",
    Status = "online",   -- online|idle|away|dnd|busy|streaming|offline|invisible; nil hides the dot
    StatusColor = nil,   -- Color3 override

    Accent = nil,        -- Color3 or scheme name; defaults to "BlueColor"
    Link = "discord.gg/example",   -- payload for buttons with Copy = true

    Buttons = {
        { Text = "Copy Invite", Icon = "copy", Copy = true },
        { Text = "Open", Style = "Secondary", Func = function(Payload) end },
    },

    BannerHeight = 64, AvatarSize = 56, Visible = true,
})
```

Button fields: `Text`, `Icon`, `Copy` (`true` = the card's `Link`, or a string of its own),
`Func(Payload)`, `Style` (`"Primary"` filled in the accent = default, `"Secondary"`
outlined), `Tooltip`, `CopiedText`, `CopyFailedText`.

Methods: `SetTitle`, `SetSubtitle`, `SetBanner(Image, Color?)`, `SetAvatar(Image, Color?)`,
`SetStatus(Status, Color?)`, `SetAccent`, `SetLink`, `SetButtons`,
`SetButtonText(Index, Text)`, `SetBannerHeight`, `SetAvatarSize`, `SetVisible`,
`GetTotalHeight`, `Destroy`.

Notes:
- A copy button flashes `CopiedText` (default `"Copied!"`) for 1.5s, or `CopyFailedText`
  (default `"Unsupported"`) when the executor has no clipboard. `Func` still runs either way.
- `Link` with no `Buttons` gives one default copy button (`CopyText` / `CopyIcon`).
- Colours given as scheme names (`"BlueColor"`, `"AccentColor"`) re-theme themselves; a
  `Color3` is pinned.
- The card sizes itself; title/subtitle/buttons each drop out when empty.

## Notifications & history

```lua
Library:Notify({
    Title = "Key System", Description = "Received", Time = 4,
    Type = "Success",        -- Error | Warning | Success | Info
    Icon = "check", BigIcon = nil, IconColor = nil,
    TitleColor = nil, DescriptionColor = nil,
    Persist = false,         -- sticky until dismissed
    Steps = nil, SoundId = nil,
})

Library:GetNotificationHistory() / :ClearNotificationHistory()
Library:ToggleNotificationHistory() / :SetNotificationHistoryVisible(bool)
Library:SetNotifySide("Left"|"Right")

Library:CreateWindow({
    NotifySide = "Right",
    NotificationHistoryLimit = 100,
    NotificationHistoryKeybind = Enum.KeyCode.RightAlt,
    DisableNotificationBell = false,
})
```

History lives in `Library.NotificationHistory` (newest first). Header bell opens the panel
and carries an unread badge; mirrored in the minimized card. Recolour via
`Library.NotificationTypeColors` (`{[string]: Color3}`).

## Pill corners, radius, DPI

`Library.PillCorners` is a third corner list beside `Library.Corners` and
`Library.SpecificCorners`: fully rounded at any radius > 0, square at 0. Applies to the
search box, buttons, slider bar/fill/ball, toggle track/ball. Keybind buttons are not
pills.

```lua
Window:SetCornerRadius(0)   -- 0..20; full corners = radius, specific = half, pills as above
Library:SetDPIScale(100)    -- percent, via Library.Scales
```

## Scheme.BlueColor

`Library.Scheme.BlueColor` (default `Color3.fromRGB(80, 155, 255)`); alias `"Blue"` /
`"BlueColor"` wherever a scheme string is accepted. Preserved by ThemeManager.

## Restyled toggles & sliders

Visual only — `AddToggle` / `AddSlider` APIs are unchanged. Toggle is a 38×20 pill; slider
has label/value above a pill bar with an oversized ball (18px on a 16px bar, 24px while
hovered/dragged). Both square off at corner radius 0. `Compact = true` sliders unchanged.

## Window glow / size / position

```lua
Window:SetGlow(Enabled, { Color = nil, Transparency = nil, Radius = nil })  -- Color follows accent
Library:CreateWindow({ Glow = true })      -- off by default (anticheats may flag it)
Window:GetSizePosition() -> Size, Position
Window:SetSizePosition(Size?, Position?)   -- clamped to viewport + min size, relayouts tabs
```

SaveManager persists size/position; skip with `SaveManager:SetIgnoreIndexes({ "WindowLayout" })`.

## SaveManager loading

Every load (Load, LoadAutoloadConfig, ImportShareCode, LoadJSON, ResetToDefaults)
validates the whole config first (nothing changes if it's broken), then fires
OnLoadBegin, applies everything in the caller's thread (layout, values, toggles
last; yielding callbacks are waited for), fires OnLoadFinish once, and returns.

```lua
SaveManager:OnLoadBegin(function(Context) end)           -- Context.Source: "Load" | "Autoload" | "Share" | "JSON" | "Reset"
SaveManager:OnLoadFinish(function(Context, Report) end)   -- once, after everything applied (or failed)
SaveManager:IsLoading() -> boolean, Context?
SaveManager:Load(Name, Options?) -> Success, ErrorMessage, Report
SaveManager:LoadJSON(JsonOrTable, Options?) -> Success, ErrorMessage, Report
SaveManager:ImportShareCode(Code, Name, Options?) -> Success, ErrorMessage, Report   -- saves only after a clean apply
SaveManager:ValidateConfig(JsonOrTable, Options?) -> Valid, ErrorMessage, Report    -- dry run
-- Options = { Mode = "Snapshot" | "Merge", Strict = bool, ResolveUnavailable = fn }
SaveManager.DefaultLoadMode = "Snapshot"   -- omitted settings reset to default; "Merge" keeps them
SaveManager:SetSelectionResolver(function(Info) return nil end)  -- Info.Index/Element/Available/Unavailable
SaveManager:SetShareExclusions({ "WebhookURL", "WebhookEnabled" })  -- out of share codes, kept in private saves
SaveManager:SetShareExcludeFilter(function(Index, Element, Data) return false end)
SaveManager.ShareExcludeURLs = true        -- inputs holding a URL never go into share codes
SaveManager:FormatReport(Report) -> "2 skipped, 1 unavailable selection(s), ..."
Dropdown:SetValue(v) -> applied, unavailable, problem   -- unavailable values are left out, never swapped
Dropdown:NormalizeValue(v) -> selection, unavailable, problem
```

Success is true only if every setting applied and no callback errored; there is no
rollback. Suspend gameplay in callbacks while `SaveManager:IsLoading()` and
reconcile once in OnLoadFinish from `Toggles` / `Options`.

## Window snapping

```lua
Library:CreateWindow({ Snapping = true, SnapDistance = ..., SnapMargin = ..., SnapAvoidCoreGui = ... })
Window:SetSnapping(Enabled, Distance?, Margin?, AvoidCoreGui?)
```

## Animation flags

`Library.Animations` (also settable per-window via `Animations = {...}` in `CreateWindow`):

| Flag | Default | Controls |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ToggleWindow` | false | window show/hide |
| `TabSwitch` | false | tab + tabbox content slide |
| `Groupbox` | false | every groupbox resize |
| `GroupboxCollapse` | **true** | the collapse/expand slide + chevron spin |
| `Dropdown` | false | dropdown open/close |
| `KeyPicker` | false | key picker menu |
| `SubTabUnderline` | **true** | sub tab / tabbox underline slide |
| `SidebarSubTabs` | **true** | sidebar nested list + chevron |

Tuning: `Library.GroupboxTweenInfo`, `Library.RotatingChevronTweenInfo`,
`TabTransitionTime`, `TabSwipeOffset`, `TabSwipeFrom` (`"left"|"right"|"top"|"bottom"`).

## Groupbox / Tabbox extras

- Collapse: `Groupbox:SetCollapsed(bool)`, `:ToggleCollapsed()`, `Groupbox.Collapsed`;
  create with `Collapsed = true` or `DisableCollapsing = true`.
- Pop out (enabled by default): `:SetPoppedOut(bool)`, `:TogglePoppedOut()`,
  `PopOut = false` to disable. Works on both Groupbox and Tabbox.
- `Library:ApplyLucideIcon(ImageGui, Icon, Rotation?)`.

## Unsupported-executor gate

`Library:CreateUnsupportedScreen(Info)` — returns `nil` when the executor is supported
(nothing is built), or a handle `{ Executor, Window, Destroyed, Destroy() }` after
building a locked-down window (660×320, no resize/minimize/search/bell).

```lua
if Library:CreateUnsupportedScreen({ Supported = { "Potassium", "Delta" } }) then return end
```

`Info` (all optional): `Title` (default `"Unsupported"`), `Icon`, `Executor` (override
detection), `Unsupported: {string}` (blocklist), `Supported: {string}` (whitelist, wins
over `Unsupported`), `Information` (`{string}` auto-numbered, or `{{Title?, Text}}`),
`Footer` (defaults to `Library.Footer`), `AlwaysOnTop`.

Matching is a case-insensitive substring test on `identifyexecutor()`. With neither list
the screen always shows. The gate has a Language dropdown that live-translates its own
copy (English, Filipino, Tiếng Việt, Bahasa Indonesia, Русский, ไทย, Deutsch); a
caller-supplied `Information` is shown verbatim.
